_comment: All tunables live here. null = leave the stock value alone.
Speeds are Unreal interpolation speeds: HIGHER = SNAPPIER, so 10000 means 'snap to target'.
Never use 0 or tiny values for lags: the camera arm blends between profiles and near-zero speeds freeze the camera.
Machine-specific paths go in config.local.json (see config.local.example.json), not here.
